EN: We could, but to be honest, I'm not really sure we can beat you.
ZH: 我们可以，但老实说，我不确定我们能打败你。

EN: No idea, but it's bound to be awesome! Why else would Vault-Tec have given us the Manual?
ZH: 不知道，但肯定是很厉害的！要不然为什么避难所科技会给我们手册？

EN: Do you understand now how doomed you are?
ZH: 你现在明白你有多完蛋了吗？

EN: Your lies can't make us stray from our path.
ZH: 你的谎言不能使我们偏离我们的道路。

EN: Dozens are still roaming the Wasteland to meet the quota.
ZH: 几十个仍在废土上游荡，以满足配额。

EN: And Death? He's not even here! He's safe from you in a secret cave.
ZH: “死亡”？他甚至不在这里！他正在秘密的洞穴里安全地待着。

EN: Isn't it more plausible that generations of Dwellers based their lives on a miscapitalization?
ZH: 一代又一代的居民的生活都是基于一个拼写错误？这个难道不是更合理吗？

EN: Then why even tell us about the secret cave?
ZH: 那为什么还要告诉我们秘密洞穴的事？

EN: Since you're about to kill us anyway, why don't you tell us where the cave is?
ZH: 既然你要杀了我们，为什么不告诉我们洞穴在哪里？

EN: Suppose you wake Death up. What then?
ZH: 假设你们唤醒了“死亡”。然后呢？

EN: Despite the best efforts of the Vault 144 Dwellers, we discovered the location of their home and that they only worship Death because “Death” was incorrectly capitalized in their Vault's instruction manual! We must now infiltrate Vault 144 and stop them from waking Death...
ZH: 尽管144号避难所的居民费尽心力，我们还是发现了他们避难所的位置，他们只崇拜“死亡”，是因为避难所指导手册里“death”被错误地首字母大写了！我们现在必须渗透进入144号避难所，阻止他们唤醒“死亡”……

EN: Operation: Sandman
ZH: 行动：睡魔

EN: Stop the Vault 144 Death cultists.
ZH: 阻止144号避难所“死亡”的信徒们。

EN: Infiltrate Vault 144 to stop the Dwellers from waking Death.
ZH: 潜入144号避难所阻止居民唤醒“死亡”。

EN: Invaders! We are Death's wake-up call!
ZH: 侵略者！我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: Trespassers! Death will be awakened!
ZH: 入侵者！“死亡”将被唤醒！

EN: Intruders! Time to help meet the quota.
ZH: 入侵者！到了满足配额的时间了。

EN: NO! We buried it under a tree, which got hit by lightning! Talk to the crew at the old RobCo plant.
ZH: 不！我们把它埋在了树下，结果树被闪电劈了！你去和旧罗伯科工厂的员工聊聊吧。

EN: Magic water my butt! This Wizard claims he discovered pre-war filtration technology...
ZH: 屁的魔法水！这个术士声称他发现了战前过滤技术……

EN: It's a bunch of hooey! Total hogwash! In fact, I wouldn't even wash my hogs with this swill!
ZH: 这是一堆废话！完全是废话！事实上，我甚至不会用这种泔水洗我的猪！

EN: As soon as we drank it we were hit by Raiders - we'd all be dead if you hadn't show up.
ZH: 一旦我们喝了它，我们被掠夺者袭击-如果你没有出现，我们都会死的。

EN: Not only that, little Johnny Jones drank it and died of disease within a day!
ZH: 不仅如此，小强尼喝了它之后一天之内就病死了！

EN: You don't have any left, do you?
ZH: 你一点都没剩了是吗？

EN: Can it be true? Has someone figured out a way to create water so powerful it can heal any ill, boost any crop, and fix any door? The people at Vault 315 should know more!
ZH: 这是真的吗？有人想出了一个方法来创造如此强大的水，它可以治愈任何疾病，提高作物产量，并修好门？315号避难所的人应该知道更多！

EN: Our Cups Runneth Over... WITH FAILURE
ZH: 我们的杯子充满了……失败

EN: Get more info on the so-called magical water.
ZH: 获取更多关于所谓神奇水的信息。

EN: Visit Vault 315 to gather information on the magical water.
ZH: 访问315号避难所收集关于神奇水的信息。

EN: You've gotten a lead to a supply of Outfits out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 你得到一个线索，废土上有一个供应装备的地方。

EN: Outfit Run
ZH: 装备大作战

EN: Recover the main stash of Outfits.
ZH: 追回主要的装备储备。

EN: Find more Outfits.
ZH: 找到更多的装备。

EN: Find more Outfits.
ZH: 找到更多的装备。

EN: Salvage any Outfits you can.
ZH: 尽量搜刮你能找到的装备。

EN: Whatever, like I care. Get ready to die!
ZH: 随便，我不在乎。准备好受死吧！

EN: Ambushed by a bunch of weirdos in camo pajamas?!?
ZH: 居然中了那群穿着迷彩睡衣的怪咖们的埋伏？！！

EN: You've brought this upon yourself, Eli Calvert.
ZH: 依莱·卡尔弗特，是你自作自受。

EN: For too long, the evil bandit Eli Calvert has raided the innocent Dwellers of the Wasteland. For the safety of your Vault, assemble your soldiers and rain death upon Eli and his gang of madmen!
ZH: 很长一段时间，恶毒的土匪依莱·卡尔弗特总是喜欢欺负无辜的居民。为了避难所的安全，召集你的战士们给依莱和他的疯子帮派下死亡通知书吧！

EN: Out of the Vault, Into the Shadows
ZH: 走出避难所，走进阴影中

EN: Kill Eli Calvert.
ZH: 消灭依莱·卡尔弗特。

EN: Destroy Eli Calvert's Raiders with your Military Death Squad.
ZH: 派遣你的军事敢死队摧毁依莱的掠夺者团伙。

EN: Nice costumes, nerds!
ZH: 衣服不错呀，书呆子们！

EN: What the..? Where did you come from?!?
ZH: 什么鬼……？你们从哪里来的？！

EN: Fine. She said something about the nuclear power plant. Now die!
ZH: 行啊。她好像提到了核电站。现在去死吧！

EN: No! You killed my precious pets! My radical Radscorpions!
ZH: 不！！你杀死了我珍贵的宠物——我那活泼的辐射蝎！

EN: First that annoying Paula Plumbkin, and now you.
ZH: 先是那个讨人厌的宝拉·普朗布金，现在又是你们。

EN: At least she had the decency to leave my babies alone.
ZH: 至少她还懂得放我的宝贝一条生路。

EN: Any final requests?
ZH: 有什么遗愿吗？

EN: Yes! Tell us where Paula Plumbkin went.
ZH: 有！告诉我们宝拉·普朗布金去哪儿了。

EN: Overseer Patel's journal indicated Paula Plumbkin had gone to Vault 909, but that it had already been overrun! Hopefully she's okay...
ZH: 监督者帕特尔的日志上显示宝拉·普朗布金去了909号避难所。但那里貌似被侵占了，希望她还好。

EN: Overrun
ZH: 侵占之殇

EN: Search Vault 909 for Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 前往909号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Search Vault 909 for Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 前往909号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Power Armor!? These Dwellers mean business!
ZH: 动力装甲？！这些居民来真的！

EN: You think those tin cans are gonna stop me from raiding these Wastes!?
ZH: 你以为就这些破铁皮就能阻止我掠夺废土吗？！

EN: There's no sense toying around with Raiders when we can just crush them! Send a group loaded with Power Armor out to a local Raider camp and deal with their Boss.
ZH: 没必要和掠夺者们周旋，直接干掉他们就行了！派遣一队穿着动力装甲的居民前往当地的掠夺者营地，和他们的首领较量一番吧。

EN: Overwhelming Force
ZH: 气吞山河

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Send a group of Dwellers in Power Armor to clear out a Raider camp.
ZH: 派遣一队穿着动力装甲的居民去清缴掠夺者营地。

EN: War may have asked for you, but you still have to earn your audience with him.
ZH: 战争可能会要求见你，但你仍得凭本事赢得与他会面的机会。

EN: And that means getting through the Warshippers.
ZH: 这意味着你必须通过“战争崇拜者”们。

EN: Dwellers! It's go time!
ZH: 居民！去吧！

EN: Absolutely. Whatever you say. I'll get right on that.
ZH: 当然。听从你的意见。我马上就可以。

EN: The codeword! Well he really just wants to talk, believe it or not, and set up a truce.
ZH: 暗号！他真的只是想谈谈，信不信由你，准备休战。

EN: The codeword! Some Raiders just started using it one day, but I think someone gave them the idea.
ZH: 暗号！有些掠夺者才刚刚开始用了一天，但我认为有人给了他们这个想法。

EN: Beagle? Eh, close enough. His confidence is easily shaken, so make him doubt himself.
ZH: 小猎犬？嗯，也差不多。他的信心很容易动摇，去让他怀疑自己。

EN: Hi, there. I'm supposed to fight you, but you've caught me all alone.
ZH: 嗨，你好。我本该和你打一场，不过你正好撞见我落了单。

EN: That's not really fair, is it? So I'll just let you by.
ZH: 这不太公平，不是吗？所以我会让你过的。

EN: War, may he enjoy Nuka-Cola forever, is around here somewhere.
ZH: “战争”就在这附近，愿他永远享受核子可乐。

EN: Is that okay with you?
ZH: 你觉得可以吗？

EN: That's fine, but you should reconsider your warring ways.
ZH: 很好，但你应该重新考虑你的交战方式。

EN: The eagle has landed. Now what does War want with us?
ZH: 鹰已降落。现在“战争”要我们做什么？

EN: The eagle soars on the wind. How did War get that name in the first place?
ZH: 鹰在风中翱翔。“战争”这个名字最早是怎么来的？

EN: The beagle runs after the ball. Does War have any weaknesses we can take advantage of?
ZH: 小猎犬追着球跑。“战争”有什么弱点我们可以利用吗？

EN: I DON'T TAKE ORDERS FROM Y... Sorry, I got caught up. No problem, we'll leave 'em alone.
ZH: 我可不听你……的命令。抱歉，我入戏太深了。没问题，我们不去动他们。

EN: Thank you. I try really hard, and it's nice to know the effort isn't wasted.
ZH: 谢谢您。我真的很努力，很高兴知道努力不会白费。

EN: Drat. I try, I really do. Here, I'll give you this if you tell the Warshippers I awed you.
ZH: 该死。我试过了，真的。这里，如果你告诉“战争崇拜者”我震慑住了你，我就给你这个。

EN: Only that... Sorry... ONLY THAT I WILL KILL HIM AND REIGN SUPREME.
ZH: 只有那……对不起……只有那样我会杀死他，然后成为最高统治者。

EN: I AM WAR, HORSEMAN OF THE APOCALYPSE, AND YOU ARE PUNY.
ZH: 我是“战争”，末日骑士，你是如此微不足道。

EN: I PROPOSE AN ALLIANCE UNTIL THE OTHER HORSEMEN ARE DEFEATED.
ZH: 我建议联盟，直到其他骑士被击败。

EN: I NEED YOU TO FIND DEATH. HIS CULTISTS ATTACKED VAULT 672. START THERE.
ZH: 我需要你找到“死亡”。他的教徒袭击了672号避难所。从那里开始吧。

EN: *cough cough* I'm sorry. Talking like that is murder on the throat. Do we have a deal?
ZH: *咳嗽*对不起。那样说话是对喉咙的谋杀。我们有交易吗？

EN: Sure, but keep your Warshippers away from innocent Settlers.
ZH: 当然，但请你的“战争崇拜者”远离无辜的人。

EN: Absolutely. You are, after all, the most powerful Horseman.
ZH: 好的。你，毕竟是，最强大的骑士。

EN: Okay, but are you *really* War? We were expecting more intimidation.
ZH: 好吧，但你真的是“战争”？我们还以为你有多吓人呢。

EN: Yes, it's a deal. What else can you tell us about Death?
ZH: 是的，这是一笔交易。关于“死亡”你还能告诉我们些什么？

EN: The Horseman, War, has invited us to discuss matters of common interest. His messenger told us the Warshippers would try to kill us, but it's worth the risk to find out what he wants! Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 骑士“战争”，已经邀请我们讨论共同感兴趣的事情。他的信使告诉我们战争崇拜者会杀了我们，但值得冒这个风险！同时，我们应该留心每周博览会记者，在他们谈论核子可乐后使用暗号“鹰”。

EN: Parley Time
ZH: 谈判时间

EN: Talk to War.
ZH: 和“战争”交谈。

EN: Meet with War, who invited you to talk.
ZH: 见“战争”，那个邀请你交谈的人。

EN: Make War, not love!
ZH: 制造战争，而不是爱！

EN: May War live forever!
ZH: 愿“战争”永生！

EN: It's a good thing War never changes!
ZH: 这是一件好事。“战争”从未改变！

EN: Mail? How 'bout you tell me what that is after we kill you?
ZH: 邮箱？不然等我们杀了你之后你再慢慢和我讲？

EN: Huh? I don't -- Shut up! I'll have your head!
ZH: 哈？我没有——闭嘴！我会要了你的命！

EN: We'll see about that!
ZH: 我们等着瞧！

EN: This party's invitation only! No squares allowed!
ZH: 这个派对不欢迎书呆子！只有收到邀请的人才能参加！

EN: Invitation? Let's just say it got lost in the mail.
ZH: 邀请？我想说我把邀请忘在了邮箱里。

EN: No squares? Then how'd you get invited?
ZH: 不欢迎书呆子？那你怎么进来的？

EN: This party's dead, and so are you.
ZH: 这个派对死定了，你们也是。

EN: One of your Dwellers came aross an old cabin in the Wasteland. Sounds like somebody's having a party.
ZH: 一位居民发现了一间小屋。听起来像是有人在开派对。

EN: Party Crasher
ZH: 不速之客

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: You found an old cabin out in the Wasteland!
ZH: 在废土发现了一间旧的小木屋。

EN: I think she mentioned visiting some Vault? Vault 333? That's a lot of threes...
ZH: 我想她好像提到了拜访某个避难所？333号避难所？好多3啊……

EN: Are you the rescue squad? I sure hope so!
ZH: 你们是救援小队的吗？老天保佑你们是！

EN: I'm Mandy Macintosh. The Feral Ghouls captured a bunch of us.
ZH: 我叫曼迪麦金托什。狂尸鬼把我们其中一些人抓走了。

EN: I think they were saving us all for a snack!
ZH: 我想它们把我们当做点心。

EN: One lady, Paula Plumbkin, managed to escape. She's my new hero!
ZH: 一位女士，宝拉·普朗布金，成功逃脱了。她是我的英雄！

EN: Did Paula say where she was going?
ZH: 宝拉有提到她去哪里了吗？

EN: The Feral Ghouls from the old Nuka-Cola plant dragged Paula Plumbkin to an abandoned building. She needs rescuing!
ZH: 旧核子可乐工厂里的狂尸鬼把宝拉拖到了一处废弃建筑里。得去救她。

EN: Paula's in a Pickle!
ZH: 宝拉被困！

EN: Rescue Paula Plumbkin.
ZH: 拯救宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Rescue Paula Plumbkin from the Feral Ghouls!
ZH: 从狂尸鬼手里拯救宝拉·普朗布金！

EN: Only my pack and I, that I know of. Though there were more...
ZH: 据我所知，只有我这个族群，曾经还有更多……

EN: Much the same as you, I presume! Come, let us be allies.
ZH: 我猜和你们学会说话的方式差不多！让我们成为盟友吧。

EN: We would be glad to meet them! Please, go tell them of us. We would like more human friends.
ZH: 我们很乐意见到他们！请把我们的事情告诉他们，我们想要结交更多人类朋友。

EN: Woah, deathclaws can talk?
ZH: 死爪会说话？

EN: More? How did you learn?
ZH: 还有更多？你们是怎么学会说话的？

EN: You were experimented on?
ZH: 有人在你们身上做实验吗？

EN: What are you doing here
ZH: 你们在这里做什么

EN: I know someone who would love to meet you.
ZH: 我认识一个人一定想见见你。

EN: I'll tell them if I see them again. Farewell!
ZH: 如果我再见到他们，我会告诉他们的。再见！

EN: Huh, alright then. Well, see you around!
ZH: 嗯，好吧。回头见！

EN: No, you're too dangerous. You have to go.
ZH: 不，你们太危险了，你们必须离开。

EN: I don't think we can trust you.
ZH: 我认为我们不能信任你们。

EN: We are aware we may seem threatening to you,
ZH: 我们知道我们可能看起来有威胁，

EN: but we are quite unlike others you may have encountered.
ZH: 但我们与你可能曾经遇到的其他死爪完全不同。

EN: Perfect Specimens
ZH: 完美样本

EN: Talk to the vault dwellers
ZH: 与避难所居民交谈

EN: Talk to the inhabitants of the mysterious vault.
ZH: 与神秘避难所的居民交谈。

EN: Mole rats have infested a Super-Duper Mart nearby. The location is a vital source of supplies for travelers. Kill the brood mother to make the location safe once again.
ZH: 附近的大无敌超市鼹鼠已经泛滥成灾。这地方是给旅行者提供物资的重要地点。除掉鼹鼠妈妈，让这个地方回归正常。

EN: Pest-Case Scenario
ZH: 害虫泛滥

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother at the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 前往大无敌超市消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Time for a little pest control!
ZH: 是时候采取点虫害防治措施了。

EN: Watch out! While exploring near a Red Rocket fuel station, one of your Wasteland explorers has stumbled across a nest of radroaches! Ewww!
ZH: 小心！在红火箭服务站附近探索时，你的一位废土探险者撞上了一窝辐射蟑螂！呃……

EN: Pest Control
ZH: 虫害防治

EN: Clear out the Radroach infestation.
ZH: 治理辐射蟑螂灾害。

EN: There's a nest of nasty Radroaches at a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
ZH: 在红火箭服务站有一窝恶心的辐射蟑螂。

EN: I forgive you. The Raiders took your friends to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
ZH: 我原谅你。掠夺者把你的朋友带去了核子可乐工厂。

EN: They went to the Nuka-Cola Factory. Now leave me in peace!
ZH: 他们去了核子可乐工厂。现在让我静静吧！

EN: Don't hurt me! The Raiders took them to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
ZH: 不要伤害我！掠夺者把他们带去了核子可乐工厂。

EN: No, the Raiders took them to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
ZH: 不在，掠夺者把他们带到了核子可乐工厂。

EN: First those Raiders kill my Radscorpion pets, now you've killed Glowy!
ZH: 先是掠夺者们杀死了我的宠物蝎子，现在你又杀死了“绿绿”！

EN: Are you people coming here just to torment me?
ZH: 你们这些人来这里就是为了折磨我的吗？

EN: I apologize. I'm just trying to find Bottle & Cappy.
ZH: 我向你道歉。我只是想找到瓶瓶和盖盖。

EN: Just tell me where Bottle & Cappy went, you weirdo!
ZH: 只要告诉我瓶瓶和盖盖去哪儿了，你这个怪咖！

EN: If you don't tell me where Bottle & Cappy went, you'll join your “pets.”
ZH: 如果你不告诉我瓶瓶和盖盖去哪里了，你将和你的“宠物”一个下场。

EN: Were Bottle & Cappy here?
ZH: 瓶瓶和盖盖在这里吗？

EN: I found out from the Ghouls living in the Poseidon Energy offices that Bottle & Cappy may have been taken to the RobCo Building. Looks like that's my next stop.
ZH: 我从住在海神能源办公室的尸鬼那里得知，瓶瓶和盖盖可能被带到了罗伯科大楼。看来那里是我的下一站了。

EN: Pet Peeve
ZH: 宠物的怨恨

EN: Search the RobCo Building for any sign of Bottle & Cappy.
ZH: 搜索罗伯科大楼，寻找有关瓶瓶和盖盖的线索。

EN: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
ZH: 追踪瓶瓶和盖盖的绑匪。

EN: Is that... Ugh. It's just a ripped Matt “The Missile” Murtagh Jersey.
ZH: 那是……呃。只是一件撕破的马特“导弹”默塔球衣。

EN: Maybe Coach is rummaging around the ruins of the old sports bar, Nick Nack Quarterback's. If he is, that Jersey's as good as ours!
ZH: 也许教练在旧的运动酒吧废墟里四处搜寻。如果他在“小摆设四分卫”那家店的话，棒球衫一定是我们的了！

EN: Picked Off at Second!
ZH: 第二次扑空！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Ugh, yeah. Been out here for a while. If you go that way, look out for the monsters.
ZH: 呃，是啊。我已经在这里呆了一段时间了。如果你往那边走，小心怪物。

EN: Ok ok! Cool your jets. Just trying to get by. Good luck, friend.
ZH: 好好！冷静点。我只是想活下去。祝你好运，朋友。

EN: What are you doing out here? You ok?
ZH: 你在这里做什么？你还好吗？

EN: Heh. Sure. Perfect.
ZH: 当然！没问题！

EN: Sure. The more the merrier. But you're carrying the loot.
ZH: 当然。人多力量大，但你要负责背战利品。

EN: Are we? Keep your hands where I can see them.
ZH: 是么？把手放在我能看到的地方。

EN: AH! Oh you startled me. Hey there don't shoot!
ZH: 啊！吓我一跳。嘿，别开枪！

EN: We're all friendly friends here, ok?
ZH: 我们都没有敌意！

EN: Woah! You took that thing out like it was nothing!
ZH: 哇！你把那东西干掉了，太厉害了！

EN: My name's Lucy! I'm just getting my bearings out here...
ZH: 我叫露西！我刚到这里……

EN: I could probably use a guide, if I'm honest. Mind if I tag along?
ZH: 说实话，我可能需要一个向导。我可以跟着你吗？

EN: Hssssthkkk!
ZH: 嘶嘶咔！

EN: Woah! What's that? This festive waterfront has suffered a ruinous fate in some kind of ill-founded fracas! Get in there and dig around, who knows what you'll find!?
ZH: 哇哦！这是什么？这个曾经热闹的海滨现在变成了废墟，好像发生了什么可怕的事！进去看看吧，说不定能找到点好东西！

EN: A Pier Into The Future
ZH: 通向未来的码头

EN: Investigate the old pier.
ZH: 调查旧码头。

EN: Investigate the old pier.
ZH: 调查旧码头。

EN: Opportunity knocks! One of your Wasteland explorers has discovered a Red Rocket fuel station that looks uninhabited. There might be something useful inside.
ZH: 机会来敲门！你的一位废土勇士发现了一个尚未被占领的红火箭服务站。里面可能有些有用的东西。

EN: Pit Stop
ZH: 加油站

EN: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
ZH: 调查红火箭服务站。

EN: Search the Red Rocket Truck Stop for supplies.
ZH: 搜索红火箭服务站的物资。

EN: You're the ones causing all the racket?
ZH: 就是你们搞出这么大动静？

EN: Listen, we caught these workers fair and square. Go find your own.
ZH: 听着，我们光明正大地抓到了这些工人，去找你们自己的吧。
